rule_definition: Deduplicate trades first by instId + tradeId
output_check: unique row count by primary key
failure_condition: Missing tradeId requires fallback key and caveat
notes: Primary key from minimal audit was present

rule_definition: If tradeId is missing in any row use instId + ts + px + sz + side for that row set
output_check: fallback duplicate count and affected rows
failure_condition: Fallback required broadly means reconstruction quality is downgraded
notes: Fallback should be rare or absent

rule_definition: Rows sharing primary key but differing in ts px sz or side must be quarantined
output_check: conflict file and checkpoint stop flag
failure_condition: Any conflicting duplicate is a hard stop
notes: Do not silently choose one row

rule_definition: Identical duplicates from pagination overlap may be dropped only if rate <=1.0% raw rows
Every cursor/page chain must be continuous enough to cover the requested time window
output_check: pagination gap count and risk label
failure_condition: Any unexplained cursor gap inside requested window is hard stop
notes: Endpoint boundary gaps must be explicitly bounded

rule_definition: Record whether pages and combined trades are ascending descending or mixed by timestamp
failure_condition: Mixed unexplained ordering that prevents coverage proof stops checkpoint
notes: Ordering can be normalized after proof

rule_definition: Assign only trades with bucket_start_utc <= ts < bucket_end_utc
failure_condition: Any out-of-interval row included invalidates bucket

rule_definition: Bucket contains only exact requested instId
failure_condition: Any nonmatching instId in bucket stops checkpoint

rule_definition: Each missing interval must have a bounded reason code
